title: Canonical tensor-Hom adjunction formula for an immersion
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $s:S\hookrightarrow X$ be an immersion with a chosen factorization $S\xrightarrow{i}U\xrightarrow{j}X$, where $i$ is closed and $j$ is open [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $Rs_!=j_!i_*$, $Rs^!=Ri^!j^*$ and let $Rs_*$ denote ordinary derived direct image; $j_!$ is exact extension by zero [lem-cbc-open-closed-recollement], and $Ri^!$ is the ambient right adjoint of $i_*$ [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], derived tensor $\otimes_A^L$ [def-kun-derived-tensor], and derived internal Hom $\mathscr H_T(U,V)=R\mathcal Hom_{A_T}(U,V)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Scheme inverse images on these categories are exact constant-coefficient inverse images [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. For $P\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ put $H=\mathscr H_S(P,Rs^!M)$. There is a natural isomorphism
$$\theta_{s,P,M}:\mathscr H_X(Rs_!P,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rs_*H$$
characterized as follows. For every $C\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $u:C\to Rs_*H$, let $\widetilde u:s^*C\to H$ be its adjoint under $s^*\dashv Rs_*$. The tensor-adjoint of $\theta_{s,P,M}^{-1}\circ u$ is exactly
$$C\otimes_A^LRs_!P\xrightarrow{\pi_s}Rs_!(s^*C\otimes_A^LP)\xrightarrow{Rs_!(\widetilde u\otimes1)}Rs_!(H\otimes_A^LP)\xrightarrow{Rs_!\mathrm{ev}}Rs_!Rs^!M\xrightarrow{\varepsilon^!_{s,M}}M.$$
Here $\pi_s$ is the canonical projection isomorphism [lem-sf-etale-generic-immersion-projection] and $\varepsilon^!$ is the counit of $Rs_!\dashv Rs^!$. No boundedness or constructibility of $C,P,M$ is required.
